entities.summary: Lucia, a notable figure in the history of Saint Lucia, associated with Indigenous Peoples of Iouanalao (2000 BCE–800). Preceded by Arawak Settlement and Agricultural Communities. Their legacy influenced Kalinago settle Saint Lucia and establish dominance c. 800 CE and Kalinago (Carib) Era.
